=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25197-25210 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason`, the new branch `elif [ "${_spahr_age_rc}" -eq 2 ] && [ "$((10#${_spahr_stall_minutes}))" -gt "$((10#${_spahr_max} * 4))" ]; then _spahr_label_age="read_error"` ends the merge-lease hold after one label-age read error (rc 2). It does this whenever the caller's stall clock is more than 4x `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_MAX_MINUTES` (5760 minutes by default). That clock is the issue's phase age (`elapsed_minutes="$(( ( $(date +%s) - status_since ) / 60 ))"`, line 28584), not the age of the `ai:merge-lease-wait` label, and the branch has no recurrence check. As a result, a hold labelled minutes ago can lapse on the first failed read.
  WHY: Once the hold lapses, `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard` (line 5422, ~5420-5505) skips the `merge_lease_wait` refusal and allows `close_and_reissue` when the head is not green, even though the issue requires the guard to fail closed (check_unavailable) on API errors. `recover_stalled_issue` (~30336-30347), the `invoke_stall_judge` judge_pick check (~24022-24039), `retrigger_review` (~29267-29277) and `resolve_merge_conflict` (~22173-22182) also stop holding, so they can dispatch a review or push an empty commit that changes the head SHA. This is a regression from the last run: before it, rc 2 always kept the hold. It also contradicts the header comment at 25148-25152. All reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high; confidence ranged from 4 to 5.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23992 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `invoke_stall_judge` re-validates `linked_pr_candidates` as an array with jq, but `_stall_judge_pick_linked_pr` has already built and validated it.
  WHY: This adds one redundant jq process on every stalled-issue tick. The source rated it NIT, mapped here to low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reviewed it and did not report it, calling it a NIT or micro-optimization with no runtime defect.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason, lines 25203-25208, reached from _stall_reissue_green_pr_guard line 5422 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rc-2 (label-age read error) 4x lapse compares against the caller's stall clock (`elapsed_minutes`, line 28584, the age of the issue's phase), not the label's age. Read errors are not cached, so one transient GraphQL failure ends the hold for any issue more than 5760 minutes into its phase, even if `ai:merge-lease-wait` was added minutes earlier. The linked issue #9641 (stall_recovery_count 2) is this case.
  WHY: The guard skips the merge_lease_wait refusal, and if the head is not green, close_and_reissue closes a lease-waiting PR despite the API failure, which violates the fail-closed check_unavailable requirement. The hold also lifts at recover_stalled_issue (~30346), invoke_stall_judge judge_pick, retrigger_review and resolve_merge_conflict. This is a regression from the last run, and test cases I and PERSIST in tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py lock it in. Suggested fix: in the guard, when the lease label is present and the hold is empty, re-call _stall_merge_lease_label_age_minutes and refuse with check_unavailable on rc 2 (about 6 lines).
- Hardening (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3): scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, _stall_reissue_green_pr_guard after line 5422. If `_srg_hold` is empty, the PR carries `${MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL:-ai:merge-lease-wait}`, and `_stall_merge_lease_label_age_minutes` returns 2, then call `_stall_reissue_guard_refuse "${issue_num}" "${_srg_pr}" "check_unavailable"; return 1` (6 lines).
- Dropped as invalid or NIT (3 related items): gemini's `_sjp_fetched_json` leak (it is declared `local -A`); gemini's redundant jq check in invoke_stall_judge (NIT); gemini's TASK_GAP about globals not being reset for a non-numeric issue (the globals are assigned before the numeric check).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~25203-25208 in `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` (and predecessor at ~25197-25199) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rc-2 4x backstop is keyed on the issue's phase stall clock (callers like line 28584), not on how long the PR has carried `ai:merge-lease-wait`. A recently labelled PR on an issue that has been in `ai:done` for more than 4 days loses its hold after one uncached GraphQL failure. This contradicts the header at ~25151 ("A single failed read therefore never ends a young hold") and reintroduces the behaviour the previous run removed. The rc-1 2x bound is defensible; rc 2 carries no information about the label's age.
  WHY: (1) The `invoke_stall_judge` judge_pick hold check (~24022-24039) returns nothing. (2) `recover_stalled_issue` (~30336-30347), `retrigger_review` (~29267-29277) and `resolve_merge_conflict` (~22173-22182) stop holding and can push an empty commit that changes the head SHA. (3) `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard` (~5420-5505) no longer refuses with `merge_lease_wait`. A green head is still refused with `green_head`, so the #9398/#9402 incident stays fixed, but a non-green head lets the close go ahead.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25200-25208 (`_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` read-error backstop), caller clock at 28584 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new rc-2 branch ends the hold on any return-2 read error, with no recurrence check. It compares against the issue's `status_since` stall clock, not the label's age, so an issue stalled for more than 5760 minutes whose PR got the lease label minutes ago loses the hold on the first failed GraphQL read. This contradicts the header at 25148-25152 and the requirement that the wait "is measured from the label's last `labeled` event". The rc-1 2x backstop is pre-existing; the rc-2 4x backstop is new.
  WHY: It hits exactly the targeted population, #9639/#9641 (`ai:done`, stall_recovery_count 2). `recover_stalled_issue`, `invoke_stall_judge` (judge_pick), `retrigger_review` and `resolve_merge_conflict` treat the held PR as not held and can dispatch a review or push an empty commit. `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard` (5422-5500) can allow `close_and_reissue` on a non-green head. The changelog's claim that the guard still refuses after a lapse covers only green heads.
- Hardening (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 4): scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` 25200-25208. Add `(.created_at // .createdAt // "")` to the `_spahr_fields` extraction (25162-25177), convert it with `date -u -d`, and allow the `read_error` lapse only when the label's age exceeds `_spahr_max`. Keep the current behaviour when the timestamp is missing (6 lines).
- Not adopted (3 related items): gemini's `_sjp_fetched_json` leak (5312-5321; `local -A` at 5265-5281, globals reset at 5252-5255); the redundant jq at 23992 (micro-optimization); gemini's TASK_GAP about the globals reset (disproven by 5252-5255 and test_stall_judge_pick_reports_none_when_nothing_is_linked).
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
